# `r if (!is.null(params$cancer_type)) paste(params$cancer_type)`

We perform, for each segment, a linear regression to detect whether patient age is significantly associated with SCNA GISTIC score. The SCNA GISTIC scores are binarized such that non-zero scores become a 1.

```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
set.seed(1)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE,
                      dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 300)
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(maftools)
library(broom)
library(tidyverse)
library(biomaRt)
library(data.table)
library(reshape2)
library(reactable)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(GGally)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)
```

}

# Functions

## Linear regression function

We perform, for each segment, a linear regression to detect whether patient age is significantly associated with SCNA GISTIC score.

```{r}
run_regression_scna <- function(se, assay, outcome, covariates = NULL, n_levels, min_group_size) {
  mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(se, assay)
  pheno <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(se)[c(outcome, covariates)])

  if (!is.null(covariates)) {
    categorical_vars <- c("gender", "race", "grade")
    categorical_vars <- categorical_vars[categorical_vars %in% covariates]
    pheno[categorical_vars] <- lapply(pheno[categorical_vars], as.factor)
  }

  if (is.numeric(pheno[[outcome]]) == FALSE) {
    pheno[[outcome]] <- as.numeric(pheno[[outcome]])
  }

  `n_-2` <- rowSums(mat == -2)
  `n_-1` <- rowSums(mat == -1)
  n_0 <- rowSums(mat == 0)
  n_1 <- rowSums(mat == 1)
  n_2 <- rowSums(mat == 2)

  keep_feature <- logical()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(mat))) {
    if (length(unique(mat[i, ])) < n_levels) {
      keep_feature <- c(keep_feature, FALSE)
      next
    }
    counts <- table(mat[i, ])
    if (all(counts >= min_group_size)) {
      keep_feature <- c(keep_feature, TRUE)
    } else {
      keep_feature <- c(keep_feature, FALSE)
    }
  }
  features_to_test <- rownames(mat)[keep_feature]

  if (length(features_to_test) == 0) {
    warning("No features passed the filtering criteria.")
    return(data.frame(
      feature_name = character(),
      beta = numeric(),
      p_val = numeric(),
      adj_p_val = numeric(),
      se = numeric(),
      stat = numeric()
    ))
  }

  base_formula <- paste0(outcome, " ~ cna_vector")
  if (!is.null(covariates) && length(covariates) > 0) {
    covariates_part <- paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
    model_formula <- as.formula(paste(base_formula, covariates_part, sep = " + "))
  } else {
    model_formula <- as.formula(base_formula)
  }

  cat("Model formula:", deparse(model_formula), "\n")

  results_df <- purrr::map_dfr(features_to_test, function(feature) {
    cna_vector <- mat[feature, ]
    model_data <- cbind(pheno, cna_vector)

    tryCatch(
      {
        test_result <- lm(model_formula, data = model_data)
        tidy_test_result <- broom::tidy(test_result) %>%
          dplyr::filter(term == "cna_vector")

        if (nrow(tidy_test_result) == 0) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        data.frame(
          p_val = pull(tidy_test_result["p.value"]),
          beta = pull(tidy_test_result["estimate"]),
          se = pull(tidy_test_result["std.error"]),
          stat = pull(tidy_test_result["statistic"])
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        warning(paste0("Regression failed for feature: ", feature, " - ", e$message))
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
  }, .id = "feature_index")

  if (nrow(results_df) == 0) {
    warning("All regressions failed.")
    return(data.frame(
      feature_name = character(),
      beta = numeric(),
      p_val = numeric(),
      adj_p_val = numeric(),
      se = numeric(),
      stat = numeric()
    ))
  }

  final_df <- results_df %>%
    mutate(feature_name = features_to_test[as.integer(feature_index)]) %>%
    mutate(
      `n_-2` = `n_-2`[feature_name],
      `n_-1` = `n_-1`[feature_name],
      n_0 = n_0[feature_name],
      n_1 = n_1[feature_name],
      n_2 = n_2[feature_name]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(feature_name, beta, p_val, se, stat, `n_-2`, `n_-1`, n_0, n_1, n_2)

  if (n_levels == 2) {
    final_df <- final_df %>% dplyr::select(-c(`n_-2`, `n_-1`, n_2))
  }
  if (n_levels == 3) {
    final_df <- final_df %>% dplyr::select(-c(`n_-2`, `n_-1`))
  }

  final_df <- dplyr::mutate(final_df, adj_p_val = p.adjust(final_df$p_val, method = "BH"), .after = p_val)
  rownames(final_df) <- NULL
  return(final_df)
}
```

## Plot age by GISTIC function

```{r}
plot_age_by_gistic <- function(segment_name, se_data, assay, segment_type, results_df) {
  gistic_scores <- assay(se_data, assay)[segment_name, ]

  plot_data <- data.frame(
    Age = colData(se_data)$Age,
    GISTIC_Score = factor(gistic_scores, levels = c("0", "1"))
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Age))

  counts <- table(plot_data$GISTIC_Score)
  count_str <- paste(names(counts), "=", counts, collapse = ", ")

  row <- results_df %>% filter(feature_name == segment_name)

  if (nrow(row) == 0) {
    adj_p <- "NA"
    stat_val <- "NA"
  } else {
    adj_p <- format(row$adj_p_val, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
    stat_val <- round(row$stat, 3)
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = GISTIC_Score, y = Age, fill = GISTIC_Score)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.8, outlier.size = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "steelblue", "1" = "orange")) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(segment_name),
      subtitle = paste0(count_str, " | adj_p = ", adj_p),
      x = "GISTIC Score",
      y = "Age (years)",
      fill = "GISTIC Score"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```

# Linear regression - segment level, thresholded, no covariates (Age ~ SCNA_level)

## Remove segments from sex chromosomes

```{r}
se <- se_segment[grep("_X", rownames(se_segment), invert = TRUE), ]
cat("After removing sex chromosome segments:", nrow(se), "segments remain\n")
```

## Run tests (no covariates)

```{r}
se_amp <- se[grep("Amplification", rownames(se)), ]
se_del <- se[grep("Deletion", rownames(se)), ]

cat("Amplification segments:", nrow(se_amp), "\n")
cat("Deletion segments:", nrow(se_del), "\n")

segment_two_level_amp <- data.frame()
segment_two_level_del <- data.frame()

if (nrow(se_amp) > 0) {
  segment_two_level_amp <- run_regression_scna(
    se_amp,
    assay = "GISTIC_thresholded_two_level",
    covariates = NULL,
    outcome = "Age",
    n_levels = 2,
    min_group_size = 10
  )
}

if (nrow(se_del) > 0) {
  segment_two_level_del <- run_regression_scna(
    se_del,
    assay = "GISTIC_thresholded_two_level",
    covariates = NULL,
    outcome = "Age",
    n_levels = 2,
    min_group_size = 10
  )
}

segment_two_level_no_cov <- rbind(segment_two_level_amp, segment_two_level_del)

if (nrow(segment_two_level_no_cov) > 0) {
  rowdata <- as.data.frame(rowData(se))
  rowdata$feature_name <- rowdata$index
  rowdata <- rowdata %>% dplyr::select(-c(index, chromosome, region_start, region_end, peak_start, peak_end, enlarged_peak_start, enlarged_peak_end))

  segment_two_level_no_cov <- dplyr::left_join(segment_two_level_no_cov, rowdata, by = "feature_name")
}

saveRDS(segment_two_level_no_cov, file.path(result_dir, "lm_test_no_covariates_results_segment_level.rds"))
cat("Saved segment-level no-covariate results to:", file.path(result_dir, "lm_test_no_covariates_results_segment_level.rds"), "\n")
```

# Linear regression - segment level, thresholded, with covariates

Covariates for `r selected_cancer_type`: `r paste(covariates, collapse = ", ")`

```{r}
segment_two_level_amp_cov <- data.frame()
segment_two_level_del_cov <- data.frame()

if (length(covariates) > 0) {
  if (nrow(se_amp) > 0) {
    segment_two_level_amp_cov <- run_regression_scna(
      se_amp,
      assay = "GISTIC_thresholded_two_level",
      covariates = covariates,
      outcome = "Age",
      n_levels = 2,
      min_group_size = 10
    )
  }

  if (nrow(se_del) > 0) {
    segment_two_level_del_cov <- run_regression_scna(
      se_del,
      assay = "GISTIC_thresholded_two_level",
      covariates = covariates,
      outcome = "Age",
      n_levels = 2,
      min_group_size = 10
    )
  }

  segment_two_level_with_cov <- rbind(segment_two_level_amp_cov, segment_two_level_del_cov)

  if (nrow(segment_two_level_with_cov) > 0) {
    rowdata <- as.data.frame(rowData(se))
    rowdata$feature_name <- rowdata$index
    rowdata <- rowdata %>% dplyr::select(-c(index, chromosome, region_start, region_end, peak_start, peak_end, enlarged_peak_start, enlarged_peak_end))

    segment_two_level_with_cov <- dplyr::left_join(segment_two_level_with_cov, rowdata, by = "feature_name")
  }

  saveRDS(segment_two_level_with_cov, file.path(result_dir, "lm_test_with_covariates_results_segment_level.rds"))
  cat("Saved segment-level with-covariate results.\n")
} else {
  segment_two_level_with_cov <- segment_two_level_no_cov
  cat("No covariates specified; using no-covariate results.\n")
}
```

### List genes in significant peaks

```{r}
if (nrow(segment_two_level_with_cov) > 0) {
  sig_peaks <- segment_two_level_with_cov %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05)

  if (nrow(sig_peaks) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(sig_peaks))) {
      cat(paste0(
        sig_peaks$feature_name[i],
        " contains ",
        sig_peaks$n_genes_in_region[i],
        " genes (",
        sig_peaks$genes_in_region[i],
        ") in the region and ",
        sig_peaks$n_genes_in_peak[i],
        " genes (",
        sig_peaks$genes_in_peak[i],
        ") in the peak.\n\n"
      ))
    }
  } else {
    cat("No significant peaks to list.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No results available.\n")
}
```

Interpretation Guide
For an Amplification Peak:

The levels 0 to 1 mean "more segment copies".
Positive beta: As amplification level increases, Age tends to increase. (Older patients have more amplifications).
Negative beta: As amplification level increases, Age tends to decrease. (Younger patients have more amplifications).
For a Deletion Peak:

The levels 0 to 1 mean "more severe deletion".
Positive beta: As the severity of deletion increases, Age tends to increase. (Older patients have more/deeper deletions).
Negative beta: As the severity of deletion increases, Age tends to decrease. (Younger patients have more/deeper deletions).

# Visualize age distributions for top 10 segments {.tabset}

Using results from linear model with covariates.

```{r}
if (nrow(segment_two_level_with_cov) > 0) {
  top_10_segments <- segment_two_level_with_cov %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(adj_p_val, n = 10) %>%
    dplyr::pull(feature_name)

  if (length(top_10_segments) > 0) {
    for (segment in top_10_segments) {
      cat("\n")
      cat(paste0("## ", segment, "\n"))
      cat("\n")
      p <- plot_age_by_gistic(segment, se, "GISTIC_thresholded_two_level", str_split_i(segment, "_", 1), segment_two_level_with_cov)
      print(p)
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No segments to visualize.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No segment results available for visualization.\n")
}
```

# Regressions - gene level

Only autosomal, protein-coding genes were kept, as documented in the data processing scripts.

```{r}
se_gene <- tryCatch(
  {
    readRDS(file.path(path_filtered_SE, paste0(selected_cancer_type, "_SCNA_GISTIC_gene.rds")))
  },
  error = function(e) {
    stop(paste0("Could not load gene-level SE for ", selected_cancer_type, ": ", e$message))
  }
)

cat("Loaded gene-level SE for", selected_cancer_type, "\n")
cat("Number of samples:", ncol(se_gene), "\n")
cat("Number of genes:", nrow(se_gene), "\n")
```

## Gene-level regressions - no covariates

```{r}
amplified_two_levels_no_cov <- run_regression_scna(
  se_gene,
  assay = "amplified_two_levels",
  covariates = NULL,
  outcome = "Age",
  n_levels = 2,
  min_group_size = 10
)

deleted_two_levels_no_cov <- run_regression_scna(
  se_gene,
  assay = "deleted_two_levels",
  covariates = NULL,
  outcome = "Age",
  n_levels = 2,
  min_group_size = 10
)

lm_test_results_list_no_cov <- list(
  amplified_two_levels = amplified_two_levels_no_cov,
  deleted_two_levels = deleted_two_levels_no_cov
)

rowdata_gene <- rowData(se_gene) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(feature_name = Gene.Symbol) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Locus.ID)

lm_test_results_list_no_cov <- purrr::map(lm_test_results_list_no_cov, ~ {
  if (nrow(.x) == 0) {
    return(.x)
  }
  .x %>%
    dplyr::left_join(rowdata_gene, by = "feature_name") %>%
    remove_rownames() %>%
    dplyr::relocate(Cytoband, .after = feature_name)
})

saveRDS(lm_test_results_list_no_cov, file.path(result_dir, "lm_test_no_covariates_results_gene_level.rds"))
cat("Saved gene-level no-covariate results.\n")
```

if (length(covariates) > 0) {
  amplified_two_levels_cov <- run_regression_scna(

    outcome = "Age",

# Visualize age distributions for top 10 genes

Using results from linear model with covariates. 5 amplified genes and 5 deleted genes (sorted by adjusted p-value, one per cytoband).

```{r}
get_top_genes_per_cytoband <- function(df, n = 10) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  df %>%
    dplyr::arrange(adj_p_val) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Cytoband, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = n) %>%
    dplyr::pull(feature_name)
}

top_genes_list <- lapply(lm_test_results_list_with_cov, get_top_genes_per_cytoband)
```

    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No deleted genes to visualize.\n")
}
